TEXT: That night ―― I'm on the phone with Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I am really sorry for what my sister did to you 
earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What about you, are you okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You didn't fight with your sister after you reached 
home, did you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ahh... no problems here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: After all, I haven't seen her since.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Yes. I already made preparations to exact 
vengeance for my boyfriend, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
The ruffian doesn't seem to be coming home 
anytime soon.
By ruffian, she means...

It seems that Kaori's staying the night somewhere 
else instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I bet she probably just met an old friend and she's 
busy hanging out with them. Leaving me behind.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...She's always been like that.

This is the first time "Saori Bajeena" has acted so 
harsh.

She has quite the grudge... she must have been 
bottling her negative emotions up.

Just like... how Kirino and I acted towards each 
other in the past.
Saori's older sister, Makishima Kaori, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hmmmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: What's with that groan, Kyousuke-shi?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
That's not the attitude you should be taking while 
on the phone with your cute girlfriend, you know~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, my bad. Lost myself in my thoughts for a while 
there.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hohoh, planning stuff out for our next date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, just my usual bad habit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Woah! So that means, will everyone's older brother, 
Kyousuke-shi, meddle with someone again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's my girlfriend. You know me so well.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Fufu, but of course. It's about my lovable 
boyfriend, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
That part of you, truly that part of you is exactly 
what made me fall for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...That so? Well then, when I'm meddling with 
someone else... could you lend me a hand?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...How reliable of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll give you the full details tomorrow then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Okay, then the meetup... oh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Oh nothing, I was just in a chat while talking to you 
on the phone...
She's very dexterous.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I was talking about hanging out with Kiririn-shi and 
Kuroneko-shi tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Um... Kyousuke-shi, I just made plans with them just 
now, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I get what you're saying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Let's all go somewhere, together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Also, we should take the chance to tell them about 
us dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You really... can say it like it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Certainly. Let's do just that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.
